plan.title: School Enrolment and Infrastructure Dashboard
plan.subtitle: Tracking enrolment trends, gender parity, and infrastructure gaps across schools

panels.title: Total Students (2024)
panels.sql: SELECT SUM(COALESCE("Girls 2024", 0) + COALESCE("Boys 2024", 0)) AS total_students FROM "school_enrolment_by_year"

panels.title: Girls Share in 2024
panels.sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(COALESCE("Girls 2024", 0)) / NULLIF(SUM(COALESCE("Girls 2024", 0) + COALESCE("Boys 2024", 0)), 0), 1) AS girls_share FROM "school_enrolment_by_year"

panels.title: Schools with Functional Girls' Toilets
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS toilet_count FROM "school_infrastructure" WHERE "Toilets functional (girls)" = 'Yes'

panels.title: Enrolment Trend by Gender (2022-2024)
panels.sql:
WITH yearly_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    '2022' AS year,
    SUM(COALESCE("Girls 2022", 0)) AS girls,
    SUM(COALESCE("Boys 2022", 0)) AS boys
  FROM "school_enrolment_by_year"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    '2023' AS year,
    SUM(COALESCE("Girls 2023", 0)) AS girls,
    SUM(COALESCE("Boys 2023", 0)) AS boys
  FROM "school_enrolment_by_year"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    '2024' AS year,
    SUM(COALESCE("Girls 2024", 0)) AS girls,
    SUM(COALESCE("Boys 2024", 0)) AS boys
  FROM "school_enrolment_by_year"
)
SELECT year, girls, boys FROM yearly_totals ORDER BY year

panels.title: Infrastructure Gaps by School
panels.sql:
SELECT 
  "School Code",
  CASE WHEN "Toilets functional (girls)" = 'No' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS missing_toilets,
  CASE WHEN "Drinking water" = 'No' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS missing_water,
  CASE WHEN "Electricity" = 'No' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS missing_electricity
FROM "school_infrastructure"
ORDER BY missing_toilets DESC, missing_water DESC, missing_electricity DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Top 10 Schools by Total Enrolment (2024)
panels.sql:
SELECT 
  "School Name",
  "Block",
  COALESCE("Girls 2024", 0) AS girls_2024,
  COALESCE("Boys 2024", 0) AS boys_2024,
  COALESCE("Girls 2024", 0) + COALESCE("Boys 2024", 0) AS total_2024
FROM "school_enrolment_by_year"
WHERE COALESCE("Girls 2024", 0) + COALESCE("Boys 2024", 0) > 0
ORDER BY total_2024 DESC
LIMIT 10

plan.narrative:
The dashboard shows a total of {{p1}} students enrolled in 2024, with girls making up {{p2}}% of the student population. This indicates progress toward gender parity in education.

Over the years, enrolment trends reveal steady growth for both genders, though the gap between boys and girls remains a focus area for intervention.

Infrastructure gaps persist, with only {{p3}} schools having functional toilets for girls. Access to drinking water and electricity also varies significantly across schools.

Addressing these gaps is critical to improving retention and learning outcomes, especially for girls who may face additional barriers due to inadequate facilities.
